ar.
- **Missing sentences:** the documents give no `debt_intro`, no reply for changing a recorded promise, and no wording for the hardship sympathy sentence.
- **Over 40 days late:** the documents don't say how to handle these facilities.
- **Opening:** I set `opening_verbatim: true` because the documents say "exactly". The same sentence tells you to change the greeting word for the time of day.

Separately, this session reported that the Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive connectors need authorising in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used. This task didn't need them.

d the time ranges aren't given.
- There's no wording for telling the customer a promise couldn't be recorded.
- The tool API's note on close reasons still names the retired outcomes "promise" and "paid".

The extraction's own `unresolved` entries all hold up. The one to look at is a declined hardship offer: Marcus's spec closes it with reason `hardship`, which the final close codes no longer have. The extraction maps it to `distress`, but that is an inference, not something the documents say.

Editing the file in place was blocked by this session's permissions, so I rewrote both files in full.

unresolved.text: No mandatory sentence introducing the reason for the call after verification; V6 only says to state the balance and days late per facility.
The documents give no reply for a customer who wants to change a recorded promise.

V12 closes a declined hardship offer as no_promise/hardship, but M9-E retires v2 codes and Section F has no 'hardship' reason; mapped to nothing_recorded/distress (the add_note enum value) by inference, not by explicit text.
V12 requires 'one short sympathy sentence' for hardship but does not dictate its wording.
M9-H replaces V13 ('does not use add_note') only 'with two facilities'; whether add_note is used when the customer has a single facility is not stated.
The documents do not say whether asking why the questions are needed counts as a refusal of verification; left at default.
verify_identity returns no hint property; unreadable values are rejected with ok=false and not counted as wrong, but no reply wording is given.
On identity exhaustion the documents only say 'state nothing about the account'; no instruction to give the customer is dictated.
Bands cover 1–40 days late only; handling of facilities more than 40 days late is not stated.

D-12 (five wrong answers instead of three; callbacks today-or-next-business-day) takes effect 1 December 2026 and is NOT applied here. The IR has no effective-date switch, so calls on or after 1 December 2026 would need wrong_answer_limit=5 and callback.days=today_or_next_business_day.
V10 'Never offer a discount, waiver or new plan.' has no dedicated IR field; it must be enforced in prompt text.
The documents do not say how a single date the customer names for several facilities is handled when it is past one facility's deadline; left at default.

V11: 'read each facility with its amount and date and ask exactly "Shall I put that down?"; only a clear yes to the final read-back allows create_promise'. It is not explicit whether one confirmation covers both facilities; one_confirmation_for_batch left at default (true).
V2 requires the opening 'exactly' but also says to 'adjust the greeting word to the time of day'; the time-of-day boundaries and alternative greetings are not given.
M9-A says to 'say plainly that it could not be recorded for that facility' but dictates no exact wording.
The API's close_call.reason description says reasons are required 'except promise and paid' (retired v2 names); per M9-F, arrangement and settled carry no reason.

audit_fixed: outcomes.table: removed invented 'when' text for handed_over, nothing_recorded, unverified, not_on_line (Section F gives none); settled 'when' now quotes Section F literally incl. '(see M9-G)'.
special_cases[restructuring].trigger: removed 'or for a new repayment plan' — not in the documents (V10 only forbids offering a new plan).

Source spans enriched: bands[0] cites V10 attempt 1; already_paid cites the V12 sentence; outcomes cites V14 goodbye; phrases cites V11 after-promise sentence; multi_product cites M9-F 'recorded promises stay'.

Added unresolved entries: D-12 effective-date switch, V10 no-discount rule without an IR field, common-date clamping, batch read-back ambiguity, opening greeting-word boundaries, M9-A failure sentence wording, stale close_call reason description in the API.
audit_unresolved: Declined hardship: V12 used no_promise/hardship; Section F has no 'hardship' reason, mapped to nothing_recorded/distress by inference.
Hardship sympathy sentence wording not dictated.
Whether add_note is used with a single facility (M9-H only covers two facilities).
Whether asking why the questions are needed counts as a decline.
No reply wording for an unreadable identity answer (API rejects with ok=false, not counted).
No instruction to give the customer after failed identity.
Facilities more than 40 days late not covered by any band.
D-12 changes (5 wrong answers, today-or-next-business-day callbacks) from 1 December 2026 are not representable by effective date.
Never offer a discount, waiver or new plan has no IR field.
Handling of one common date past one facility's deadline not stated.
Whether one read-back confirmation covers both facilities.
Greeting-word time-of-day boundaries for the opening.
Wording for a failed promise write.
No debt_intro sentence and no recorded-promise change reply in the documents.
API close_call.reason description still names retired v2 outcomes (promise, paid).
